sections.heading: Subject-matter Insured
sections.body: Industrial chemicals, solvents, specialty intermediates and allied raw materials in drums, IBCs, ISO tanks and bags, imported by the Insured in the ordinary course of trade, excluding hazardous cargo of IMDG Class 1 and Class 7, and goods shipped on deck unless specifically declared and accepted.

sections.heading: Voyages and Conveyance
sections.body: From any port or place in the world to Nhava Sheva (JNPT), Mumbai Port or Mundra Port, including inland transit by road or rail to the Insured's warehouse at Navi Mumbai or Taloja. Carrying vessels must be classed with a member of IACS and comply with the Institute Classification Clause.

sections.heading: Basis of Valuation and Declarations
sections.body: CIF value plus 10 percent, plus import duty where specifically declared. The Insured shall declare every shipment before commencement of transit, or within the time allowed under the Declaration Clause, and the sum insured shall stand reduced by the value of each declared consignment.

sections.heading: Clauses and Conditions
sections.body: Institute Cargo Clauses (A) 1/1/09, Institute War Clauses (Cargo) 1/1/09, Institute Strikes Clauses (Cargo) 1/1/09, Institute Classification Clause, Inland Transit (Rail or Road) Clause (A), Termination of Transit Clause (Terrorism) and Sanctions Limitation and Exclusion Clause. Excess: 0.5 percent of consignment value, minimum as per endorsement, each and every claim.

sections.heading: Claims Procedure
sections.body: In the event of loss or damage, notify the Company's claims cell immediately, apply for survey by the nominated surveyor, lodge monetary claims on carriers and port authorities within the prescribed time, and preserve all rights of recovery. Documents required include bill of lading, commercial invoice, packing list, bill of entry, survey report and copy of claim lodged on carriers.

sections.heading: Grievance Redressal
sections.body: For any grievance, contact the Grievance Officer at the Registered Office or write to grievance@sahyadrigeneral.example.in. If unresolved, the Insured may approach the Insurance Ombudsman or the IRDAI Bima Bharosa portal. This schedule is to be read together with the policy wording and endorsements attached.
